diagnosis: kernel_check_invariants: `physical_large == ordered_large && "dense ordered stream disagrees with its large mirror"` after a Vivify step with Eliminate's mixed dense stream attached by the stress policy. Vivify's promote_irredundant turned a redundant clause irredundant and pushed it into the `large` membership mirror only, never into `ordered`, so the two views of the attached image disagreed and BVE's mixed-stream traversal would miss the promoted clause. Kissat's dense watches are one list, so the promotion is one append there. Fixed by routing the promotion through the kernel primitive kernel_dense_add_large_occurrence, which appends to every attached view; kernel_add_large_clause and kernel_replace_large_clause_in_place now share that primitive. Under the pre-repair source the older BVE assertion `garbage == garbage_prefix.size()` was reached on this case at the last passing campaign's commit (f51a988); the current source's outcome on that path is validated by the campaign legs.
